_comment: Prevent Damage (2026-09-27, phase I1). Purity: 'If noncombat damage would be dealt to you,
prevent that damage. You gain life equal to the damage prevented this way.' Board: Purity,
Tamanoa, Vito (sick; resumed at main 1), one untapped Battlefield Forge, empty hand. The sweep
taps the Forge coloured; its 1 damage is PREVENTED (so it is not dealt, and Tamanoa does NOT
trigger) and Purity gains 1 instead -- ONE lifegain event, so Vito drains 1. Us 21, opponent 19.
If Tamanoa wrongly triggered on the prevented damage the opponent would read 18.
